Odisha SIR faces alleged voter exclusion; Delhi SIR shows low clearance

The Biju Janata Dal (BJD) questioned Odisha's Supplementary Electoral Roll (SIR), alleging that more than 27 lakh eligible voters were excluded. In Delhi, the SIR process reports that only 0.7 percent of the 3.16 million voters have cleared discrepancy hearings so far.
